home.h1: The Lean 4 Library for Quantum Computing and Quantum Information
home.lead: Built on mathlib4 and Physlib, Qatlib formalizes mathematical foundations, reusable algorithmic primitives, and theorems and resource bounds from the literature.
home.cap1: Add to lakefile.toml (Lean {toolchain}), then pull prebuilt Mathlib + Physlib + Qatlib caches:
home.cap2: Fetch all three cache tiers in one command and build incrementally:
home.sec_arch_h2: Strict One-Way Dependency: Foundations ← Concepts ← Papers
home.sec_arch_p: Enforced statically in ~1 second by lake lint and audited in the Lean 4 kernel by lake test.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.description: Shared operator analysis, trace & Schatten norms, positive semidefinite order, mixed-state fidelity, concentration bounds, graph Laplacians, and finite-precision arithmetic.

concepts.title: Concepts
concepts.description: Reusable quantum channels & entropy, block-encoding algebra, QSVT/QSP, LCU, amplitude amplification, quantum walks, query/adversary bounds, fermionic/bosonic spaces, and QEC.

papers.title: Papers
papers.description: Selected model definitions, technical lemmas, main theorems (MainResults/), and end-to-end query/gate/qubit resource bounds organized by research paper.
